summary: Iteration 17: Complete testing of email-based authentication system overhaul. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend tests passed. The auth system successfully migrated from username to email-based authentication with auto-generated 10-char passwords.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: Admin model (models/admin.py) correctly uses 'email' field instead of 'username'
GOOD: Login endpoint (routes/auth.py) accepts email+password, case-insensitive email lookup
GOOD: Register endpoint auto-generates 10-char alphanumeric password using secrets.choice()
GOOD: Password reset generates new 10-char random password, invalidates old password
GOOD: Token verification returns email (not username) in response
GOOD: JWT sub claim contains admin email for all protected route lookups
GOOD: Frontend LoginPage.jsx shows 'Email' label and input field
GOOD: Frontend password reset dialog shows email field and displays generated password
GOOD: SettingsTab.jsx shows 'Email:' with user?.email (not username)
GOOD: AuthContext.jsx login() sends email in request body
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 tested the complete email-based auth overhaul. Frontend login page at /admin/login shows Email field. Password reset dialog shows email input and displays generated password. Settings tab shows Email: instead of Username:.
